title: Local sandboxing in the GitHub Copilot app
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Copilot app public preview adds per-project local sandbox policy for filesystem, network and credentials, with enterprise settings able to tighten the effective policy.
actionable_takeaway: Before local agent sessions, record requested sandbox policy, enterprise overrides, session scope and whether the OS can enforce it.

title: OpenTelemetry in the GitHub Copilot app
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Enterprise-managed OTel lets organizations trace Copilot agent sessions, model calls and tool use in existing monitoring systems while prompt/response content stays excluded by default.
actionable_takeaway: Treat telemetry as an observability contract: endpoint, labels, content-capture setting and retention must be explicit.

title: More ways to request and configure Copilot code reviews
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Copilot code review now has a dedicated personal settings page, automatic review controls for PR states and pushes, and enterprise-level default review effort inheritance.
actionable_takeaway: Separate personal defaults, enterprise defaults, org/repo overrides and one-off manual review effort in review receipts.

title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub Actions runners now use Node 24 for JavaScript actions, the temporary insecure Node opt-out is gone, and old macOS or ARM32 self-hosted runners are outside support.
actionable_takeaway: Scan JavaScript actions for runs.using=node20 and verify self-hosted runner OS/architecture before the next release train.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.156.1 stable
author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Codex stable adds GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna to the model picker and updates the rate-limit switch prompt to recommend Luna.
actionable_takeaway: Update Codex model routing receipts so Sol/Luna selection is recorded with task shape, cost intent and fallback behavior.

title: Copilot CLI 1.0.89-1 prerelease
author: GitHub Copilot CLI Releases
why_it_matters: The prerelease adds GPT-6 Sol/Luna to the picker, fixes line-range handling in view tools, and keeps queued prompts queued when recalling a pending message.
actionable_takeaway: In CLI agent receipts, distinguish pending-message recall from queued prompt execution and verify file view ranges.

title: OpenAI Node 7.23.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: Node SDK adds GCP external storage support, GPT-Rosalind research model identifiers, and documentation for exact Chat Completions seed bounds.
actionable_takeaway: Treat SDK upgrades as data-plane changes: storage provider, model allowlist and deterministic seed tests all need readback.

title: OpenAI Python 3.19.2 / 3.19.1
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: Python SDK fixes fallback file extraction, single-pass tool iterables and case-insensitive header merging while clarifying web-search location, Realtime modalities and fine-tuning bounds.
actionable_takeaway: Add fixtures for one-shot tool iterables, fallback file extraction and approximate web-search location defaults before bumping runtime dependencies.

title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna in the OpenAI API changelog
author: OpenAI API Changelog
why_it_matters: OpenAI documents GPT-6 Sol and Luna availability for Responses and Chat Completions, including standard token pricing and long-context pricing caveats.
actionable_takeaway: Keep API model routing tied to price tier, context length and cache assumptions, not just model labels seen in a picker.

title: Agents API managed Codex harness
author: OpenAI API Docs
why_it_matters: The Agents API gives applications durable sessions, managed Codex orchestration, context compaction, recovery, sandboxes, MCP connections and subagent delegation.
actionable_takeaway: Design hosted agents with session, environment, events and billing receipts before adding autonomous write tools.

title: Bringing my LED display to life with GPT-Live-1 and Codex
author: OpenAI Developers
why_it_matters: The project combines Voice in ChatGPT desktop, Codex-built rendering skills, a Mac renderer, local network DDP frames and later GPT-Live-1 delegation to update a physical LED wall.
actionable_takeaway: Prototype voice-to-device workflows by splitting human feedback, local renderer, device controller and model delegation into separate receipts.

title: Claude Code 2.1.281
author: Anthropic / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Claude Code 2.1.281 is a dense comparator for agent reliability: gateway policies, Bedrock guardrails, MCP validation, resume repair, stream recovery, dangerous rm prompts and setting propagation.
actionable_takeaway: Use it as a cross-agent checklist for resume integrity, prompt-cache preservation, sandbox trust and dangerous-command handling.
